payload.title: Embed optional Cyclotron priming with existing reference curation planners
payload.description:
As a Papyrus editor I want reusable Cyclotron preview and explicit label controls in References, so I can curate representative examples before relevance operation.
Feature: Optional reference priming
  Scenario: Research source
    Given the existing scholarly reference extraction path
    When a configured HTTP curation service transforms a source for priming
    Then existing extraction yields title and abstract without registering source content in GraphQL
  Scenario: Web source
    Given the existing web extraction and metadata/summary path
    When a source is prepared for priming
    Then the full validated decision representation is previewed and source provenance is retained
  Scenario: Embedded controls
    Given host-supplied authenticated priming transport
    When the References view enables optional example import
    Then the shared Cyclotron preview and label/rationale controls are rendered
    And cancellation or rejection never commits an example
Local tested slice only; no schema plugin framework, IAM change, provider calls or deployment. Linked core initiative decision-flywheel-da886c09-7acb-45d3-acf8-c81585f26d8a.
